title: HTS data of human gamma and delta repertoires from peripheral blood, DOT and naive vs differentiated V delta 1 T cells
description:
This study aims at characterizing the gamma and delta repertoires of human V delta 1 T cells of different origins:

- Sorted Vdelta1 T cells from peripheral blood;

- Sorted Vdelta1 T cells from DOT cells (Almeida, Clin Cancer Res, 2016);

- Sorted naive CD27+ naive and CD27- differentiated Vdelta1 Tcells from peripheral blood.

samples.title: Human sample from Homo sapiens
attributes: Sorted Vdelta1 cells from buffy coat of Donor 1 - Gamma chain
Instituto Portugus do Sangue e da Transplantao
